change: Add a Line or plane mode to the span workshop

mutations.name: a pair with a negative u₁v₂ − u₂v₁ is called a line
a pair with one ⟨0, 0⟩ is called a point
any line pair counts as pointing opposite ways
a line is drawn at right angles to its arrows
mutations.replace: const w0=this.isZero(this.u(i)) ? this.v(i) : this.u(i), w=[-w0[1],w0[0]], n=

mutations.name: a call still moves once the round is right
